noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

prop.description:
If specified, uses the annotation value as the React Component prop field name, rather than the c3 type field or
function name.

skipToReactProps.description: When set on a field, the field will be skipped when converting the field to props

skipComponentReferenceMerge.description:
When set on a field in a type, if that type is annotated with @react(componentReference = true) in another type,
this annotation allows the field value on that instance to take priority over the received componentReference
props. The field value will not be merged over from the received props.
Ex: {@link ConsoleKendoGrid.RowIndexHeaderCell#onClick} Our custom logic in ConsoleKendoGrid.RowIndexHeaderCell.js
attaches a UiReactMouse.Click event handler which will then get converted to `onClick` prop.
{@link KendoGridColumnProps.headerCell} is annotated with `@react(componentReference=true)`. When Kendo supplies
props to the React component type instance, it will also supply an `onClick` handler. The handler defined in
ConsoleKendoGrid.RowIndexHeaderCell.js should always prevail, thus the usage of this annotation to indicate that
the props generated from the UiComponent instance should not be overridden should a collision happen when it is
used on a field that is annotated with `@react(componentReference=true)`.

title:
Annotation to assist in the transformation from UiComponent to React Component props.
If specified on a function, the function will be passed along as a prop value (essentially treated as a lambda)
name: Ann.React
